items.action: None, unless a table must keep the faint resize line it had: set `--ds-table-resize-line-color: var(--border-default)` on that `ds-table`.
items.appliesWhen: A `ds-table` with `dsTableResize`. A table without it draws no resize line.
items.verify: At rest, a resizable `ds-table` header shows a `--text-tertiary` line at each column edge, unless `--ds-table-resize-line-color` is set.

informational: New component `ds-attachment` (`AttachmentComponent`): a file chip with a type tile or image preview, name and size, for the `[chips]` slot of `ds-message-input`. Adds `AttachmentKind` and the optional `DsIntl.attachment` keys. Nothing to change in your code.

New component `ds-message-input` (`MessageInputComponent`): an auto-growing message box with `[chips]`, `[actions]` and `[send]` slots, Enter to submit, `busy` / `busyLabel` and `(filesPasted)`. Adds the optional `DsIntl.messageInput` keys `label` and `send`. Nothing to change in your code.

informational.text: A focused `ds-table` resize handle draws no outline; its line becomes `--focus-ring-width` wide in `--focus-ring-color`, inset `--space-1` from the cell's top and bottom. Forced-colours mode keeps the outline.
informational.verify: Tab to a column resize handle: the line at the column edge turns the focus colour and wider, with no ring around the handle.

informational: `ToastService` can fold repeated toasts into one `×N` stack under `provideDsConfig({ toast: { groupDuplicates: true } })`, or by `ToastOptions.groupKey`; off by default. Adds `ToastOccurrence`, `ToastEntry.groupKey` and `ToastEntry.occurrences`, the `ds-toast` input `occurrences` and output `occurrenceClosed`, `ToastRegionComponent.stackFor`, and the optional `DsIntl.toast` keys `showAll`, `hide`, `dismissAll` and `repeated`. Nothing to change in your code.

informational.text: Under `data-theme="dark"`, `--shadow-1` to `--shadow-4` and every `--shadow-*` and `--ds-elevation-*` alias built on them are near-black at 30% to 60% alpha instead of a light glow, `--shadow-4` adds a 1px light hairline at 8% alpha, and `--shadow-tint-l` is `3%`.
informational.verify: In the dark theme open a modal and a popover and read their computed box-shadow: every layer is a dark rgba, and the modal's first layer is `0 0 0 1px` at 0.08 alpha.
